einzeiler: Megyn Kelly discusses serious allegations against Thomas Markle and Meghan Markle's…
kurzfassung: Megyn Kelly breaks down the shocking investigation into Meghan Markle's father, Thomas Markle, regarding illicit material. She questions why Meghan waited eight years to address the allegations publicly. Later, Glenn Greenwald joins to discuss the situation alongside other political and cultural news.
stichpunkte: Thomas Markle Sr. is reportedly under investigation for possessing child sexual abuse material.
Meghan Markle released a statement admitting she knew about the allegations since a 2018 letter.
Megyn Kelly questions Meghan's lack of action over the past eight years despite knowing these serious claims.
Thomas Markle Sr. and his daughter Samantha vehemently deny the allegations, claiming the equipment was out of his possession.
Glenn Greenwald joins the show to discuss the shocking implications and media reactions.
The discussion also covers new immigration fraud allegations against Representative Ilhan Omar.
Additional topics include J.D. Vance's stance on Israeli elections and criticisms of Alex Cooper's podcast advice.

clips.hook: Family members inventing horrific accusations seems unthinkable.
clips.text: The discussion touches on the instinctual disbelief people have regarding fabricated and extreme claims made within families.

clips.hook: Official documents require accurate representations of identity.
clips.text: A legal expert emphasizes the absolute necessity of using real names on passports and congressional filings.

clips.hook: Being put on the spot with a direct yes-or-no question.
clips.text: An interviewer presses for a straightforward endorsement, forcing a careful avoidance of a direct answer.

clips.hook: The answer to questioning a marriage is always yes.
clips.text: A discussion on relationship advice suggests that leaving a partnership is invariably the correct choice when doubts arise.

beschreibung:
Megyn Kelly discusses the serious allegations about Meghan Markle's father emerging related to CSAM, what Meghan Markle really knew about the allegations based on a supposed 2018 letter, why she didn't do more at the time or in the past eight years, the timeline from Meghan Markle about when she learned the allegations against her father and the serious questions it raises, her and Prince Harry's past comments about why they stopped contact with Markle's father, the exact horrifying allegations against Meghan Markle’s father, the family drama exploding into the public now involving her half-brother and sister, and more. Then Glenn Greenwald, host of "System Update" on Substack, joins to discuss the curious Meghan Markle statement released immediately after allegations against her father became public, whether she should have stayed silent, the evidence that “Ilhan Omar” isn’t even Ilhan Omar's real name, whether the case against Ilhan Omar is politically motivated, the many possible instances of immigration fraud that she has committed, what happens next with Ilhan Omar, whether Ilhan Omar could be removed from Congress soon, if Kamala Harris’ new accent sounds like AOC, her struggles to excite the crowds on the campaign trail, President Trump's big endorsement of Bibi Netanyahu, what Fox News attacking JD Vance over his answer on Israel and Netanyahu reveals, the recent Alex Cooper podcast with Sophia Bush and their terrible advice for women about marriage, how their past makes them terrible messengers, and more.

More from Greenwald: https://greenwald.substack.com/
